title: Phase 7B final (Stage-B) pre-registration: accuracy-preserving sustainable structured pruning with sensitivity-aware PPO (SimpleCNN, CIFAR-10)
frozen_rule: Nothing below changes after this file is committed. Stage-B results are reported as they are.

structured_space.rule: k = max(1, round((1 - r) C)) channels with the largest L1 norm (Paper-3 backend)

proxy.landscape: all 1,296 policies recovered once at E epochs

surrogate.features: E_1000 = a + b * L_table (measured Paper-3 batch-1 latency, ms)

reward.feasible: R = 1 + alpha * s_hat / s_max + epsilon * q

alpha_tuning.rule: alpha with the lowest median predicted energy of the seeds' selected policies; ties -> smaller alpha

archive_and_selection.archive: every distinct proxy-feasible policy visited during training
archive_and_selection.selection: lowest predicted energy; within 1% tied -> higher q, lower MACs, lower parameter memory, smaller action vector
archive_and_selection.empty_archive: no selected policy; counted as a failure (GREEN-SUCCESS = NO)
archive_and_selection.primary_new_ppo: most frequent selected policy over the 20 confirmatory seeds; ties -> lower predicted energy, then smaller action vector
archive_and_selection.enumeration_reference: the same selection rule over all proxy-feasible policies (reported, not a method)

baselines.uniform: common ratio on a 0.001 grid 0.0-0.9 minimizing |MACs - MACs_new_ppo| (ties -> smaller ratio)
baselines.lamp: src.pruning.lamp on the dense reference at global sparsity on a 0.1% grid 0.0-90.0%; unit ratio = zeros/weights of the unit; the sparsity whose structured realization has the parameter count closest to new_ppo's (ties -> smaller sparsity)
baselines.old_ppo: Phase-7A PPO-Structured [0,2,5,5], frozen checkpoint reused read only (Phase-7B dense recovery verified bit-identical to Phase 7A's, same protocol and data stream)

recovery.protocol: Phase-6 finetune: Adam lr 1e-4, cosine over 5 epochs, batch 128, crop+flip, seed 600

memory.primary: parameter bytes = sum(numel * element_size) over parameters

computation: conv/linear MACs per image (closed form, checked against hooks)

energy_protocol.backend: RAPL package counter via Windows Energy Meter Interface (no TDP, no estimate)

pilot.unstable: N doubles once; still unstable -> STOP

energy_protocol.order: non-dense models once and Dense 3 times, one random order per session
energy_protocol.conditions: AC, Balanced plan, batch 1, 1 intra-op and 1 inter-op thread, CPU 2, fresh process per session, system load <= 15.0%

statistics.energy_reduced: lower than same-session dense in 5/5 sessions AND median saving > noise threshold
statistics.latency_reduced: median-over-sessions latency below dense AND lower in 5/5 sessions
statistics.tests: exact one-sided Wilcoxon vs dense (min p = 0.031); paired comparisons descriptive
statistics.edp: normalized (E x latency) / (E_dense x latency_dense), per session, median

green_success.rule: accuracy preserved (VAL-SELECT) AND memory reduction > 0 AND MAC reduction > 0 AND latency reduced AND energy reduced

cases.GREEN-A: new_ppo GREEN-SUCCESS and neither Uniform nor LAMP has a better trade-off
cases.GREEN-B: new_ppo GREEN-SUCCESS but Uniform or LAMP has a better trade-off
cases.GREEN-C: memory, MACs and energy improve but accuracy fails
cases.GREEN-D: accuracy preserved but energy not reduced
cases.otherwise: reported as none of GREEN-A-D with the failed criteria

comparison_rule.baseline_better: comparable VAL-SELECT accuracy (|d| <= 0.5 pp) and baseline E_1000 lower in 5/5 sessions, or baseline accuracy higher by > 0.5 pp with median E_1000 not higher (Phase-7A rule)
comparison_rule.new_ppo_better: the same with the roles exchanged

green_frequency: GREEN-SUCCESS of each confirmatory seed's selected policy (5-epoch recovered and measured); seeds without a selection count as NO
stop_conditions: a step would need a frozen rule changed
next_architecture: ResNet-8 only after the SimpleCNN results are frozen; no CIFAR-100
